Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS OR MODDROP. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
____________

Hi, I've been asked about the black stone floor I've been using in some of my screenshots. I thought I'd put it up for download.
The original can be found [here](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/), if you like the grey stone better. 

Things that were changed:
- stone floor to black stone 
- cobblestone to grey (by taintedwheat on Chucklefish Forums)
- stepping stone to grey (by taintedwheat on Chucklefish Forums)
- straw floor was removed from straw cause I hated the straw
- gravel path was turned into the greenhouse tiles
- wood path was made less orange

UPDATED:
- crystal floor and crystal path were replaced with two new ones. 

I won't take requests on this. I added the png so you can edit the attributes you want to change yourself :-)
